title.narrative: Parametric Climate Risk (tropical cyclone and/or excess rainfall) Insurance: a) Payment of the reinsurance premiums to cover part of the risk related to climate related events of COSEFIN participating countries insured by CCRIF and b). Payment of insurance payouts to COSEFIN participating countries in the event a tropical cyclone, excess rainfall or other climaterelated events occur and the occurrence of such climate event constitutes an insured event.c) Finance technical assistance for the development of an excess rainfall insurance product to be provided to COSEFIN Participating countries.

description.narrative: Parametric Climate Risk (tropical cyclone and/or excess rainfall) Insurance: a) Payment of the reinsurance premiums to cover part of the risk related to climate related events of COSEFIN participating countries insured by CCRIF and b). Payment of insurance payouts to COSEFIN participating countries in the event a tropical cyclone, excess rainfall or other climaterelated events occur and the occurrence of such climate event constitutes an insured event.c) Finance technical assistance for the development of an excess rainfall insurance product to be provided to COSEFIN Participating countries.

title.narrative: Statuts of climate risk related policies for COSEFIN (Council of Ministers of Finance of Central America, Panama and the Dominican Republic) member countries provide increasing insurance coverage

description.narrative: Statuts of climate risk related policies for COSEFIN (Council of Ministers of Finance of Central America, Panama and the Dominican Republic) member countries provide increasing insurance coverage

comment.narrative: There is no information on the expected level of advance in the final target climate risk related policies for COSEFIN member countries provide increasing insurance coverage and it is not set at the Baseline Matrix.

An assumption has been made a COSEFIN member country provides a increased insurance coverage when a tropical cyclone or excess of rainfall policy is purchased. As no other information is available in the advance report a table of Status of Country Engagement in Central America Annex 2 has been used to determine the countries that have purchased climate risk policies from the Central America and Caribbean Catastrophe Risk Insurance Program
